authors: Liu, Yunyun; Huang, Bin
citation: Phosphorus, Sulfur and Silicon and the Related Elements (2016), 191(6), 926-929
reference: Three-component reactions of phosphorus ylides, thiophenols, and acetyl chloride for the synthesis of (β-thioacrylates) | Liu, Yunyun; Huang, Bin | Phosphorus, Sulfur and Silicon and the Related Elements (2016), 191(6), 926-929
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General procedure for the synthesis of β-sulfenylated acrylates 4. A 25-mL round-bottom flask was charged with thiophenol 1 (0.5 mmol), acetyl chloride 2a (0.5 mmol), Wittig reagent 3 (0.5 mmol), Cs2CO3 (1.0 mmol), Et3N (0.5 mmol), CH2Cl2 (2 mL), and DMF (2 mL).The vessel was stirred at 100°C(reflux) in air atmosphere (1 at air balloon) for 10 h. Upon completion (TLC), the reaction mixture was allowed to cool down to room temperature and H2O (5 mL) was added. The resulting suspension was extracted with ethyl acetate (3 × 8 mL). The organic phases were combined and dried over Na2SO4. After filtration and removing the solvent at reduced pressure, the residue was subjected to silica gel column chromatography by using 100:1 (v/v) petroleum ether/ethyl acetate as an eluant to give pure product. Ethyl (E)-3-[(4-bromophenyl)thio]but-2-enoate (4h). Colorless liquid. 1H NMR: δ = 7.49 (d, 2H, J = 8.4 Hz), 7.28 (d, 2H, J = 8.4 Hz), 5.15 (s, 1H), 4.01 (q, 2H, J = 7.0 Hz), 2.35 (s, 3H), 1.15 (t, 3H, J=7.0Hz); 13C NMR: δ =165.0, 157.8, 136.7, 132.9, 129.2, 124.4, 112.3, 59.6, 19.8, 14.2. HRMS (ESI):m/z [M+Na]+ Calcd. for C12H13BrNaO2S: 322.9717; Found: 322.9722.

experimental_procedure: General procedure: To a screw-capped pressure tube were added anhydrous CH2Cl2 (1.0 mL), aldehyde 3 (0.50 mmol), and phosphorane 2a (175.0 mg, 0.55 mmol). Then the tube was sealed and heated to 80 °C until the full consumption of 3 indicated by TLC analysis. The solvent CH2Cl2 was removed under reduced pressure and then DMF (1.0 mL) and (R,R)-1 (30.1 mg, 0.05 mmol) were added. The resulting solution was stirred at -30 °C for half an hour before TMSCN (125 μL, 1.0 mmol) was charged. After TLC analysis indicated the end of the reaction, the reaction mixture was poured into NH4Cl (sat.), after usual work-up procedure and column chromatography using PE/Et2O (10:0 to10:1) as the eluent could afford the corresponding products 5. The reaction with 3a was conducted for 12 hours for step 1 and 3 days for step 2; Column chromatography afforded 5a in 71% yield as colorless oil.26 The isomeric composition of the product: 90% ee. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General procedure: To a screw-capped pressure tube were added anhydrous CH2Cl2 (1.0 mL), α,β-unsaturated enal 10 (0.5 mmol), and phosphorane 2 (175.0 mg, 0.55 mmol). Then the tube was sealed and heated to 80 °C until the full consumption of 10 indicated by TLC analysis. After the reaction mixture was cooled to room temperature (rt), (salen)AlCl (R,R)-1 (30.3 mg, 0.05 mmol) was added. The resulting solution was cooled to -30 or -40 °C (as indicated above) and stirred for half an hour before the addition of TMSCN (1.0 mmol). After TLC analysis indicated the full conversion of the trans-6 (cis-6 was unreactive in step 2 in most cases), the mixture was directly subjected for column chromatograph, and product 7 was isolated using petroleum ether/diethyl ether (from 100:0 to 10:1) as the eluent. The reaction with 10a was conducted for 25 hours for step 1 and 2 days for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7a in 70% yield as pale yellow oil. The reaction with 10e was conducted for 15 hours for step 1 and 2 days for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography gave product 7e in 77% yield as pale yellow oil. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: Synthesis of (E)-N,N-Dibutyl-2,5-dimethoxy-4-(2-(4′-methyl-2,2′-bipyridin-4-yl)vinyl)aniline (17). The monophosphonate (2, 0.32 g, 1 mmol) and the aldehyde (5b, 0.29 g, 1 mmol) were dissolved in 20 mL of dry THF. Then, potassium tert-butoxide (0.224 g, 2 mmol) was added to the reaction mixture at 0 °C under nitrogen atmosphere; ice bath was then removed and stirred at room temperature for 1 h. The resulting dark colored solution was quenched with 10 mL of water, and the product was extracted with dichloromethane. The organic layer was washed several times with water and with brine and dried over Na2SO4, and the crude product was purified by column chromatography using silica gel (100-200 mesh) using methanol/ dichloromethane 5:95 v/v as the eluent. Synthesis of 4-(2,5-Dibutoxy-4-(2,5-dimethoxy-4-(pyrrolidin-1- yl)styryl)styryl)-4′-methyl-2,2′-bipyridine (23). This compound was synthesized following the same procedure for 17. Aldehyde 15b (0.24 g, 1 mmol) was used instead of aldehyde 5b. The crude product was purified through column chromatography using silica gel (100-200 mesh) and methanol/dichloromethane 5:95 v/v as mobile phase. Compound 23 as a dark red microcrystalline solid. Yield: 0.22 g (71%). reference: Asymmetrically Substituted and π-Conjugated 2,2'-Bipyridine Derivatives: Synthesis, Spectroscopy, Computation, and Crystallography | Bodapati, Ramakrishna; Sarma, Monima; Kanakati, Arunkumar; Das, Samar K. | Journal of Organic Chemistry (2015), 80(24), 12482-12491
experimental_procedure: Synthesis of (E)-4-Methyl-4′-(4-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)styryl)-2,2′-bipyridine (16). In the presence of nitrogen atmosphere, potassium tertbutoxide (0.22 g, 2 mmol) was added at 0 °C to a solution of monophosphonate (2, 0.320 g, 1 mmol) and the aldehyde (7a, 0.175 g, 1 mmol) in 20 mL of THF; the ice bath was subsequently removed, and the reaction mixture was stirred at room temperature for 1 h. After the completion of the reaction, the reaction mixture was quenched with 10 mL of water, and the product was extracted with dichloromethane. The resulting mixture was washed several times with water and then with brine. The yellow colored material obtained was washed with ether, dried in air, and then further purified on a silica gel (100-200 mesh) column using methanol/dichloromethane 5:95 v/v as the eluent to obtain the compound 16 as a dark brown colored solid. Yield: 0.23 g (72%). IR spectrum (ν/cm-1): 2970, 2926, 1738, 1366, 1229, 1217. 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3): δ 8.56 (d, J = 5 Hz, 2H), 8.46 (s, 1H), 8.27 (s, 1H), 7.45 (d, J = 9 Hz, 2H), 7.40 (d, J = 16 Hz, 1H), 7.33 (d, J = 4 Hz, 1H), 7.15 (d, J = 5 Hz, 1H), 6.89 (d, J = 16 Hz, 1H), 6.56 (d, J = 9 Hz, 2H), 3.33 (t, J = 6 Hz, 4H), 2.45 (s, 3H), 2.02 (t, J = 6 Hz, 4H). 13C NMR (100 MHz, CDCl3): δ 155.1, 155.0, 148.1, 147.8, 147.2, 147.1, 145.9, 132.9, 127.5 (2C), 123.6, 122.5, 121.0, 119.5, 119.4, 116.7, 110.7 (2C), 46.5 (2C), 24.4 (2C), 20.1. HRMS (ESI/TOF-Q) m/z: (M + H)+, calcd for C23H24N3 342.1970, found 342.1970. Anal. Calcd for C23H23N3: C, 80.90; H, 6.79; N, 12.30. Found: C, 80.72; H, 6.71; N, 12.41.

authors: Lalwani, Komal G.; Sudalai, Arumugam
reference: A Concise Enantioselective Synthesis of (+)-L-733,060 and (+)-T-2328 via Sequential Proline Catalysis | Lalwani, Komal G.; Sudalai, Arumugam | Synlett (2016), 27(9), 1339-1343
experimental_procedure: tert-Butyl (4S,5S,E)-5-((tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino)-4-hydroxy-5-phenylpent-2-enoate (5): To a stirred pre-cooled (-10 °C) acetonitrile (15 mL) solution of β-aminoaldehyde 6 (1 g, 4.01 mmol) and nitrosobenzene (360 mg, 3.34 mmol) was added L-proline (77 mg, 20 mol%).2 The reaction mixture was allowed to stir at the same temperature for 20 h followed by the addition of Ph3P=CHCO2tBu (1.91 g, 5.01 mmol) to the reaction mixture, which was stirred for further 6 h at 0-25 °C. After addition of phosphate buffer, the resulting mixture was extracted with EtOAc (3 × 30 mL) and the combined organic phases were dried over anhyd. Na2SO4 and concentrated to give the crude aminooxy unsaturated ester, which was directly taken up for the next step without purification. To a MeOH (20 mL) solution of the above crude aminooxy unsaturated ester was added Cu(OAc)2.H2O (140 mg, 0.67 mmol) at 25 °C and the reaction mixture was allowed to stir for 10 h at that temperature. After addition of phosphate buffer, the resulting mixture was extracted with CHCl3 (3 × 30 mL) and the combined organic phases were dried over anhyd. Na2SO4 and concentrated to give the crude product, which was then purified by column chromatography over silica gel using pet. ether:EtOAc (7.5:2.5). Syn-aminohydroxy cinnamic ester 5 (1.02 g). Yield: 70%, colorless liquid. Chiral purity: 93% ee by chiral HPLC analysis (Chiracel AD-H 250 x 4.6 mm), n-hexane/i-PrOH, 80:20, 0.5 mL/min, 254 nm). experimental_procedure: General procedure: To a screw-capped pressure tube were added anhydrous CH2Cl2 (1.0 mL), α,β-unsaturated enal 10 (0.5 mmol), and phosphorane 2 (175.0 mg, 0.55 mmol). Then the tube was sealed and heated to 80 °C until the full consumption of 10 indicated by TLC analysis. After the reaction mixture was cooled to room temperature (rt), (salen)AlCl (R,R)-1 (30.3 mg, 0.05 mmol) was added. The resulting solution was cooled to -30 or -40 °C (as indicated above) and stirred for half an hour before the addition of TMSCN (1.0 mmol). After TLC analysis indicated the full conversion of the trans-6 (cis-6 was unreactive in step 2 in most cases), the mixture was directly subjected for column chromatograph, and product 7 was isolated using petroleum ether/diethyl ether (from 100:0 to 10:1) as the eluent. The reaction with 10a was conducted for 25 hours for step 1 and 2 days for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7a in 70% yield as pale yellow oil. The isomeric composition of the product: 91% ee. HPLC analysis (Chiralcel OJ-H, i PrOH/hexane = 1/99, 1.0 mL/min, 230 nm; tr (major) = 16.67 min, tr (minor) = 13.64 min). [α]D 25 = -31.2 (c = 1.0, CHCl3); 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3): δ 7.43-7.41 (m, 2H), 7.34 (t, J = 8.0 Hz, 2H), 7.28-7.24 (m, 1H), 6.75-6.64 (m, 3H), 5.74 (d, J = 14.8 Hz, 1H), 1.70 (s, 3H), 0.24 (s, 9H); 13C NMR (100 MHz, CDCl3): δ 136.66, 135.68, 132.96, 131.43, 128.79, 128.27, 126.71, 126.49, 120.80, 69.76, 30.90, 1.49; IR (ATR) ν 3027.45, 2959.79, 1642.71, 1490.92, 1253.12, 1099.57, 989.31, 842.06, 747.14, 690.40 cm-1; MS (EI): 271 (M+, 58), 256 (66), 228 (62), 182 (24), 157 (100), 129 (51), 115 (21), 73 (92). HRMS (EI): Exact mass calcd for C16H21NOSi: 271.1392; found: 271.1394.

experimental_procedure: Synthesis of (E)-N,N-Dibutyl-2,5-dimethoxy-4-(2-(4′-methyl-2,2′-bipyridin-4-yl)vinyl)aniline (17). The monophosphonate (2, 0.32 g, 1 mmol) and the aldehyde (5b, 0.29 g, 1 mmol) were dissolved in 20 mL of dry THF. Then, potassium tert-butoxide (0.224 g, 2 mmol) was added to the reaction mixture at 0 °C under nitrogen atmosphere; ice bath was then removed and stirred at room temperature for 1 h. The resulting dark colored solution was quenched with 10 mL of water, and the product was extracted with dichloromethane. The organic layer was washed several times with water and with brine and dried over Na2SO4, and the crude product was purified by column chromatography using silica gel (100-200 mesh) using methanol/ dichloromethane 5:95 v/v as the eluent. Compound 17, which is a dark red colored thick gum.Yield: 0.36 g (78%). experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General procedure: To a screw-capped pressure tube were added anhydrous CH2Cl2 (1.0 mL), aldehyde 3 (0.50 mmol), and phosphorane 2a (175.0 mg, 0.55 mmol). Then the tube was sealed and heated to 80 °C until the full consumption of 3 indicated by TLC analysis. The monophosphonate (2, 0.32 g, 1 mmol) and the aldehyde (5b, 0.29 g, 1 mmol) were dissolved in 20 mL of dry THF. Then, potassium tert-butoxide (0.224 g, 2 mmol) was added to the reaction mixture at 0 °C under nitrogen atmosphere; ice bath was then removed and stirred at room temperature for 1 h. The resulting dark colored solution was quenched with 10 mL of water, and the product was extracted with dichloromethane. The organic layer was washed several times with water and with brine and dried over Na2SO4, and the crude product was purified by column chromatography using silica gel (100-200 mesh) using methanol/ dichloromethane 5:95 v/v as the eluent. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General procedure: To a screw-capped pressure tube were added anhydrous CH2Cl2 (1.0 mL), α,β-unsaturated enal 10 (0.5 mmol), and phosphorane 2 (175.0 mg, 0.55 mmol). Then the tube was sealed and heated to 80 °C until the full consumption of 10 indicated by TLC analysis. After the reaction mixture was cooled to room temperature (rt), (salen)AlCl (R,R)-1 (30.3 mg, 0.05 mmol) was added. The resulting solution was cooled to -30 or -40 °C (as indicated above) and stirred for half an hour before the addition of TMSCN (1.0 mmol). After TLC analysis indicated the full conversion of the trans-6 (cis-6 was unreactive in step 2 in most cases), the mixture was directly subjected for column chromatograph, and product 7 was isolated using petroleum ether/diethyl ether (from 100:0 to 10:1) as the eluent. The reaction with 10a was conducted for 25 hours for step 1 and 2 days for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7a in 70% yield as pale yellow oil. The reaction with 10o was conducted for 21 hours for step 1 and 2.5 days for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7p in 75% yield as pale yellow oil. The isomeric composition of the product: 91% ee. HPLC analysis (Chiralcel OJ-H+OJ-H, i PrOH/hexane = 5/95, 0.8 mL/min, 230 nm; tr (major) = 20.26 min, tr (minor) = 23.24 min). [α]D 25 = -34.7 (c = 1.0, CHCl3); 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3): δ 7.45-7.43 (m, 2H), 7.36 (t, J = 8.0 Hz, 2H), 7.29-7.27 (m, 1H), 6.89-6.82 (m, 1H), 6.68-6.59 (m, 3H), 6.37-6.31 (m, 1H), 5.69 (d, J = 15.2 Hz, 1H), 1.71 (s, 3H), 0.26 (s, 9H); 13C NMR (100 MHz, CDCl3): δ 137.01, 136.16, 134.36, 132.64, 131.31, 130.47, 128.76, 128.32, 127.99, 126.60, 120.77, 69.76, 30.86, 1.47; IR (ATR) ν 2967.1, 1665.1, 1448.0, 1254.0, 1188.0, 1119.0, 999.2, 842.9, 748.7, 688.9 cm-1; MS (EI): 297 (M+, 54), 282 (27), 254 (21), 208 (25), 183 (30), 155 (100), 115 (22), 73 (82); HRMS (EI): Exact mass calcd for C18H23NOSi: 297.1549; found: 297.1546.

experimental_procedure: Ethyl (2Z)-(8-nitro-2H-1,5-benzoxathiepin-3(4H)- ylidene)ethanoate (17) To a stirred solution of 0.3 g t-BuOK (2.6 mmol) in 15 cm3 THF at 0 °C was added 0.44 cm3 triethylphosphonoacetate (2.2 mmol).
